---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

> Issues are a feedback channel for this owner-controlled solo-development project. Suggestions do not become roadmap commitments automatically and do not invite unsolicited code pull requests.

## Problem / use case

What problem should this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired behavior from the user's perspective.

## Why it belongs in Prompt Control Deck

Explain how it fits the local-first Suno/Vault workflow.

## UI / workflow impact

Describe where the feature should appear and how it should behave in Dark/Light mode and DE/EN where relevant.

## Data / compatibility impact

Does this require changes to stored data, factory data, permissions, imports, exports, or Suno selectors?

## Commercial / licensing impact

Does this introduce third-party code, assets, services, APIs, datasets, or licenses? If yes, list them.

## Additional context

Mockups, screenshots, or implementation notes are welcome. Do not include secrets or private user content.
